sdd-core.description: Core SDD pipeline plus base authoring utilities. Always installed; cannot be excluded.

quality.description: Optional adversarial code-review skills. Installed by default; opt out with --without quality.

review.description: 4R adversarial review lenses (risk, readability, reliability, resilience) plus the refuter, selected by the orchestrator's deterministic triage. Installed by default; opt out with --without review.

optional.description: Optional modules: the GitHub Projects kanban-github board, the sdd-learn MEMORY.md curator, the sdd-brainstorm decision-ledger interview, the kurama-report upstream failure reporter, and the systemic-issue-triage root-cause partitioner. Installed by default; opt out with --without optional — which now drops FIVE skills. Installing the kanban-github module does not activate the board — activation stays opt-in per project via kanban.enabled. The other four are active as soon as they install; when one is absent the orchestrator skips its handoff (post-archive, brainstorm gate, upstream report, batch triage) silently. kurama-report lives here on purpose: a user who does not want outward-facing reports to myst4/kurama drops the group and the path stops existing.

tdd.description: TDD module: the RED-GREEN-REFACTOR protocol skill (skills/tdd). Installed by default; opt out with --without tdd. Installing the module does not activate TDD — activation stays opt-in per project (a project can start without tests and add them later).
